title: FRANKENSTEIN Phase 1 Financial Phrase Sample
subtitle: Small reproducible finance-NLP sample with provenance for agent research
description:
FRANKENSTEIN Phase 1 research dataset for testing a simple GitHub ↔ Kaggle ↔ Hugging Face data workflow.

This package contains a three-row demonstration sample derived from the FinancialPhraseBank dataset hosted on Hugging Face.

Upstream dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/lmassaron/FinancialPhraseBank
GitHub project: https://github.com/Saehon/Saeid-Homayoun/tree/main/FRANKENSTEIN
GitHub provenance manifest: https://github.com/Saehon/Saeid-Homayoun/blob/main/FRANKENSTEIN/data_registry/phase1_huggingface/manifest.json

Purpose: education, academic research, reproducibility, and provider-neutral accounting/audit agent experiments.

The full upstream dataset remains on Hugging Face. This Kaggle package intentionally contains only a tiny demonstration sample plus provenance metadata.

License: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, matching the upstream Hugging Face dataset metadata. Attribution and non-commercial/share-alike requirements remain applicable.
